summary: Align Cargo and flake pty pins at f8388fe7 for Darwin daemon identity and bounded session socket paths

compatibility.detail: Move pty from 1ae8c187 to f8388fe7, including pty#145's Darwin daemon identity and bounded long-session socket paths. Direct terminal connections and terminal views resolve the producer's published socket address instead of assuming <id>.sock. The intervening pty changes also include identity-safe launch operations, attachment-loss reporting, bounded output queues, enhanced-paste support, and packet batching (#137). No Smalltalk database or wire API changes.

manual.detail: No manual action required; matching Cargo and flake pins preserve the evaluation-time assertion and unblock the downstream fleet repin.
